title: Personnel of the band that played blues in the street
summary: Miller and Allen try to name the trombones, baritone, alto, clarinet and trumpet players in that band, including Pills and Eddie Jackson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
